source_evidence: 10 THE OTHER SIDE OF ZERO Integers More and more numbers!
Recall that the very first numbers we learned about in the study of mathematics were the counting numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, … Then we learned that there are even more numbers!
For example, there is the number 0 (zero), representing nothing, which comes before 1.
The number 0 has a very important history in India and now in the world.
